title: Saudian Dry-Meat Delight
description: A rich, velvety curry paste-based dish featuring dried meat, perfect for a hangover cure or a quick meal. This Saudi-Arabian delicacy is surprisingly easy to make.

ingredients.name: Dried beef (or lamb) strips
ingredients.notes: Look for thinly sliced, high-quality strips

ingredients.name: Thai red curry paste
ingredients.notes: Spicy and aromatic, add depth to the dish

instructions: In a spice grinder or mortar and pestle, grind 1 teaspoon of black pepper and 1 teaspoon of salt into a fine powder.
Heat 1 tablespoon of coconut oil in a tava-griddle over medium-high heat.
Add the dried beef strips and cook for 3-4 minutes or until browned, stirring frequently.
Remove the beef from the tava-griddle and set aside.
In the same tava-griddle, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of coconut oil.
Add the Thai red curry paste and cook for 1-2 minutes or until fragrant, stirring constantly.
Add the honey, candy pieces, and 1 tablespoon of fresh lime juice to the tava-griddle.
Stir to combine, then add the ground pepper and salt mixture.
Return the beef to the tava-griddle and stir to coat with the curry paste mixture.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5-7 minutes or until the flavors have melded together and the sauce has thickened.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot.
